column1: Ernie Clement leads the slate with strong hit probability and a reliable track record, reaching safely in over 72% of games this season while batting near the top of the Cubs’ lineup. Matt Olson is a close second, showing excellent recent form and benefiting from a favorable home matchup with the platoon edge. Ozzie Albies and Jacob Wilson also offer steady profiles with consistent opportunities, but Clement’s combination of consistency and lineup spot stands out for Beat The Streak players.
